This came one day after President Donald Trump claimed SpaceX chief Elon Musk ended speed caps affecting Ukraine's drone capabilities. Even advanced infrastructure depends on rules and access limits.

signal.rationale: This is a news discussion with no actionable trading setup.

clips.text_en_b2: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Ukraine is still dealing with speed limits on its military-grade Starlink connection. This came just one day after President Donald Trump claimed that SpaceX chief Elon Musk had lifted the caps affecting Ukraine's drone capabilities. Even cutting-edge infrastructure is useless if access depends entirely on compliance, since rules and restrictions can undo years of technical progress overnight.
